narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Bi means two, so a billion is ten to the power two.
<bookmark mark='small'/>Ten to the power two is only one hundred, but a billion is ten to the power nine.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The two must count something else, so the bubble is wrong.

narration: <bookmark mark='k1'/>To check, take three plus three times the prefix number.
<bookmark mark='k2'/>For trillion, three plus nine is twelve, which matches ten to the power twelve.
